examples.question: How much do we owe borrowers in total, and how many loans?
examples.sql: SELECT refund_rupees, refund_loans, gap_loans, unexplained_loans FROM SAHI_ASK.run_summary

examples.question: How much do we owe borrowers whose money was disbursed by cheque in 2024?
examples.sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(l.excess_paise) / 100 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS owed_rupees, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loans FROM SAHI_ASK.refund_ledger l WHERE l.loan_id IN (SELECT m.loan_id FROM SAHI_ASK.money_in_hand m WHERE m.payment_mode = 'CHEQUE' AND YEAR(m.resolved_date) = 2024)

examples.question: Which RBI practice accounts for the most refund?
examples.sql: SELECT l.practice_code, p.title, CAST(SUM(l.excess_paise) / 100 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS owed_rupees, COUNT(DISTINCT l.loan_id) AS loans FROM SAHI_ASK.refund_ledger l LEFT JOIN SAHI_ASK.practices p ON p.practice_code = l.practice_code GROUP BY l.practice_code, p.title ORDER BY 3 DESC

examples.question: At BR001, are loans sanctioned after the July 2024 fix still being overcharged?
examples.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN sanction_quarter >= '2024-Q3' THEN 'sanctioned from Jul 2024' ELSE 'sanctioned before' END AS cohort, SUM(loans_overcharged) AS loan_quarters_overcharged, CAST(SUM(excess_paise) / 100 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS excess_rupees FROM SAHI_ASK.cohorts WHERE branch_id = 'BR001' AND period_quarter >= '2024-Q3' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

examples.question: How much posted interest is waiting on evidence from branches?
examples.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS tranches, CAST(SUM(posted_paise_at_stake) / 100 AS DECIMAL(18,2)) AS posted_rupees_at_stake FROM SAHI_ASK.evidence_gaps
